content.comment_body: I'm interested in this and have a question: Is it possible to adjust the delay time using a potentiometer connected to an analog input like AI1 or AI2? Thanks.
Yes, this can be done. You can use any available analog input for this purpose. It’s also possible to change a time parameter based on temperature readings.
Okay, how do I adjust the parameter T (off delay) on, for example, a timer off-delay function using a 0-10 V analog input? Thanks.
